theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme that is simultaneously eligible, ranked #1, trend-tagged, and high-breadth (0.833). In a one-narrative regime, leadership concentration is real but not a return forecast. This is not a buy-the-leader call; it is a conditional lean that if the absolute-trend gate were to work here, Banks are the one theme it would permit long exposure to. The crowding flag (z=1.72) is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: The trend gate did not hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so eligibility may be a false positive that catches Banks right before a violent mean-reversion in the crowded, one-narrative leader.

This is a diversification-of-eligible-names lean, not a momentum call.
